criteria.description: Settings UI separates persistent operator relay policy from browser-session relay overrides.
Relay policy saves publish ContextVM method settings/relay-policy.apply with browser, ContextVM, service, NIP-66 monitor, DM 10050, and NIP-86 target fields.
Backend validates relay policy payloads, rejects invalid relays/targets, and publishes canonical 30900 state plus 4903 audit on accepted mutations.
NIP-86 calls go through ContextVM method settings/relay-admin.call and are restricted to configured Bahia-owned or Bahia-authorized targets and allowed relayadmin methods.
Documentation and event implementation guidance describe the ContextVM/state/audit path and local-only browser override boundary.
